parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A unique token used to ensure idempotence of the request. This value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request. Default value: the language configured in the browser. Valid values:

- en: English
- zh: Simplified Chinese
- zt: Traditional Chinese
- es: Spanish
- fr: French
